column1: # H59 reconciliation task (28 Sept 2026): the NW-aligned draft of the two sign passes f108v3z_signsA/B.tsv (tools/reconcile_passes.py); 'sign' = pass A's code where the passes differ, 'alt' = the other pass's code (A:- or B:- = that pass has no sign in this column), 'why' = agree / agree-flagged (both passes agree, one at low confidence: NOT to settle) / the kind of disagreement.
